title: Preview fixture v1 (P1 empty providers)
description: Closed input, at most 1 MiB. Both empty services and empty events must be explicit. P1 rejects nonempty provider or event declarations before mount with E_UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY; typed providers and events arrive in P3. Missing providers never imply permission to construct live services. Saved artifacts preserve the exact input bytes and their SHA-256 digest.
